blocks.title: Relationships · the people in your life

items.cz: tchán a tchyně / příbuzní z manželovy strany

sentences.en: My old classmate now works in the building where I live.
sentences.cz: Můj bývalý spolužák teď pracuje v budově, kde bydlím.
accepts: My old classmate now works in the building where I live

sentences.en: She is a close friend, but I did not tell her about the job.
sentences.cz: Je to blízká kamarádka, ale o té práci jsem jí neřekl.
accepts: She is a close friend, but I did not tell her about the job

sentences.en: He is only an acquaintance, not a real friend, so I never call him.
sentences.cz: Je to jen známý, ne opravdový kamarád, takže mu nikdy nevolám.
accepts: He is only an acquaintance, not a real friend, so I never call him

sentences.en: We have a relative in Vienna who never writes, but she always sends money.
sentences.cz: Máme ve Vídni příbuznou, která nikdy nepíše, ale vždycky posílá peníze.
accepts: We have a relative in Vienna who never writes, but she always sends money

sentences.en: My flatmate leaves the kitchen dirty when he cooks at night.
sentences.cz: Můj spolubydlící nechává kuchyň špinavou, když v noci vaří.
accepts: My flatmate leaves the kitchen dirty when he cooks at night

sentences.en: My in-laws come for lunch on Sunday, but they never stay long.
sentences.cz: Tchán s tchyní chodí v neděli na oběd, ale nikdy nezůstanou dlouho.
accepts: My in-laws come for lunch on Sunday, but they never stay long

sentences.en: Her godparent still writes to her every birthday, but they never meet.
sentences.cz: Její kmotr jí pořád píše ke každým narozeninám, ale nikdy se nevidí.
accepts: Her godparent still writes to her every birthday, but they never meet

sentences.en: A stranger helped us when the car would not start.
sentences.cz: Když auto nechtělo nastartovat, pomohl nám cizí člověk.
accepts: A stranger helped us when the car would not start
A stranger helped us when the car wouldn't start

sentences.en: My ex still lives in the same street, but we never speak.
sentences.cz: Můj bývalý pořád bydlí ve stejné ulici, ale nikdy spolu nemluvíme.
accepts: My ex still lives in the same street, but we never speak

sentences.en: He went to the match with an old mate who lives in Plzeň.
sentences.cz: Šel na zápas se starým kamarádem, který bydlí v Plzni.

sentences.en: The bride was late because the taxi did not come.

sentences.en: The groom forgot the ring because he changed his jacket.
sentences.cz: Ženich zapomněl prstýnek, protože si převlékl sako.

sentences.en: I get on with my colleagues, but I never see them at weekends.

sentences.en: I trust him with the keys, but not with the money.

sentences.en: Students respect a teacher who listens to them.
sentences.cz: Studenti si váží učitele, který jim naslouchá.
accepts: Students respect a teacher who listens to them

sentences.en: I admire people who start again after fifty.
sentences.cz: Obdivuju lidi, kteří po padesátce začnou znovu.

sentences.en: You can rely on Petra when the work is difficult.

sentences.en: Loyalty means more than money when the company is small.
sentences.cz: Loajalita znamená víc než peníze, když je firma malá.

accepts: Their friendship started at school because they sat at the same desk

sentences.cz: Je těžké rozejít se s člověkem, který tě pořád miluje.
accepts: It is hard to break up with a person who still loves you

sentences.cz: Bratři se často pohádají kvůli penězům, ale do léta na to zapomenou.

sentences.en: Do not ignore the message, because she is waiting.

Don't ignore the message, because she is waiting
Don't ignore the message, because she's waiting

sentences.en: It is easy to let down a friend when you are busy.
sentences.cz: Je snadné zklamat kamaráda, když máš moc práce.

sentences.cz: Na té oslavě byl odtažitý, protože měl tátu v nemocnici.
accepts: He was distant at the party because his father was in hospital

sentences.en: They argue every week, but they always make up.
sentences.cz: Hádají se každý týden, ale vždycky se udobří.

sentences.en: They met on a date that her sister planned.

sentences.en: The romance ended when he moved to Ostrava.

sentences.cz: Rodiče slaví výročí v hotelu, kde se brali.

sentences.cz: Sraz ze školy byl ve stejné hospodě, ale přišlo jen deset lidí.
